questions.promptEn:
Plus 기타 지문 01  (p.224 After You Read - B)
What is AI?
AI stands for "Artificial Intelligence."
It is a kind of computer system.
It can understand language and make decisions like humans.
How is AI used in everyday life?
It can recommend new videos to watch.
It can recognize your face to unlock your phone.
What should I be careful about?
When you use AI, you should keep accuracy, originality, and privacy in mind.

Q1 AI cannot understand human language.

questions.explainKo: 정답: T. 목소리만으로 TV와 불을 켜고 끌 수 있다. (답지 p.44 Plus 기타 지문 02)
questions.promptEn:
Plus 기타 지문 02  (p.224 After You Read - C)
I use an AI speaker at home. I can use it to turn the TV and lights on and off with just my voice. It's really helpful when I'm getting ready to go out.

Q2 The user can control the TV and lights by speaking.

questions.explainKo: 정답: F. 그 로봇은 팔이 많이 달린 거미처럼 생겼다. (답지 p.44 Plus 기타 지문 03)
questions.promptEn:
Plus 기타 지문 03  (p.224 Think and Write)
I saw a cleaning robot in a sci-fi movie. It looked like a spider with many arms. It knew how to clean well and quickly. It could clean lots of places at once with its many arms. It would be great to have this robot because I could save time on cleaning.

Q3 The robot had only two arms to clean.
